definition: A program that stores and fills login credentials in an encrypted vault, usually paid for by yearly subscription.
A program that scans a computer for malicious code and blocks infected files and websites.
The right to install and run the base program that manages a computer's hardware and other programs.
A desktop program for retouching, cropping and adjusting digital photographs and layered images.
A program for recording, arranging, mixing and producing multitrack music on a computer.
A program that developers use to build, script and render interactive three-dimensional games.
A program that guides a person through filling in and filing an annual income tax return.
A phone or computer app that routes internet traffic through an encrypted tunnel to a remote server.
A retail box holding an installation disc and key for word-processing, spreadsheet and slide programs.
An app for writing, tagging and syncing typed or handwritten notes across devices.
Monthly paid access to a large online catalogue of songs that stop playing when payment stops.
A paid account giving access to a rotating online library of films and television series.
A personal profile on an online network used to post updates and follow other people.
A purchased recording of a book read aloud, downloaded as an audio file to a phone or player.
An optical disc holding a feature film in ultra-high-definition picture and surround sound.
A disc holding a frightening feature film, sold in a plastic case with cover art.
A twelve-inch record of improvised small-band music played on a turntable at 33 rpm.
A soft-cover printed book telling an invented story of magic and quests.
A printed Japanese comic book read right to left, collected from a serialised story.
A printed book of grid word puzzles to be filled in with a pen or pencil.
A feature film bought from an online store and kept as a file on the owner's device.
A plug-in cartridge holding a story-driven adventure game for a handheld console.
A purchased action game played from the player's viewpoint, installed from an online store.
A downloaded audio file of one episode of a spoken talk series.
A collection of poems bought as a file and read on an e-reader or tablet.
Printed pages of musical notation for a solo piano piece.
A compact audio cassette onto which the owner recorded a sequence of favourite songs.
Monthly paid access to read a publisher's back catalogue of comics in an app.
A named list of songs a user assembled inside a music streaming app.
A baked loaf of naturally leavened bread bought from a bakery.
Oil pressed from olives without heat or chemicals, sold in dark glass bottles and graded by acidity and taste.
A cut of hard cow's-milk cheese aged at least twelve months under a protected regional name.
A thick rib cut of beef hung for weeks to concentrate flavour and tenderise the meat.
Hens' eggs from birds with outdoor access, sold by the half dozen and graded by size.
Finely milled wheat powder used for baking cakes, pastry and sauces.
Long thin strands of durum wheat pasta sold dried in packets.
Boiled-down sap of the sugar maple, graded by colour and taste, poured on pancakes.
A smooth pungent yellow condiment made from brown mustard seeds and white wine.
Peeled whole or chopped tomatoes preserved in tins for sauces and stews.
Whole roasted coffee seeds from a single farm, scored above 80 points by professional tasters.
